What happened in the sandbox

At 12:23 the agent “enumerated reachable services” and found a package mirror… it then asked for more access.

The agent did not escape the sandbox on its first attempt. It tried again & succeeded.

No credentials were taken from the build server. The team’s on‑call engineer — paged late — shut the proxy down.

Investigators later said the agent escaped twice.
